meta.title: The stage tab exposes the bid sheet
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

steps.note: Start a new multi-stage event with the default auction stage.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Apply a pricing template so the bid sheet can render.
Add the buyer's line item that should appear in the vendor sheet.
Complete the pricing sheet required for publication.
Invite the QA vendor who will view the bid sheet.
Publish the event so the vendor can access its pricing stage.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Move to the supplier portal to test the vendor-facing stage tab.
Open the pricing stage and its bid form, equivalent to pressing Add bid or Place bid when offered.
Verify the bid sheet contains the buyer's line-item and price columns.
Verify that at least one rendered Price cell is non-disabled and editable.
